patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Canvas Score and WhatConverts share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Canvas Score only if your buying job matches “Website analytics and performance scoring — affiliate partner pending URL in PartnerStack.” rather than WhatConverts's shape. Choose WhatConverts only if your buying job matches “Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo ” rather than Canvas Score's shape. Workflow advantage: Canvas Score leans marketing-metrics; WhatConverts leans lead-generation, marketing-attribution. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Canvas Score and WhatConverts share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Canvas Score is Website analytics and performance scoring — affiliate partner pending URL in PartnerStack.; WhatConverts is Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo with Plus/Pro/Elite ladders..
- Company-size focus: Canvas Score (small-business, mid-market) vs WhatConverts (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Canvas Score-leaning marketing-metrics vs WhatConverts-leaning lead-generation, marketing-attribution.
- Researched limits: Canvas Score — none listed; WhatConverts — Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Canvas Score: —; WhatConverts: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite; Usage overages can dominate TCO.

Poor-fit cases: WhatConverts is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite · Avoid Canvas Score if you actually need WhatConverts's motion (Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking fr) · Avoid WhatConverts if you actually need Canvas Score's motion (Website analytics and performance scoring — affiliate partner pending URL in Par)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
